payload.title: Every Anthus website runs on Papyrus with Anthus-flavored Markdown (Markus)
payload.description:
Direction from Ryan (2026-10-17): dogfood everything. Every Anthus website is authored as Markus (Anthus-flavored Markdown) and built/served by Papyrus, with no bespoke Gatsby, Next marketing or Quarto/mkdocs pipelines left.

## Inventory (2026-10-17, read from each repo's default branch)

Already on Papyrus + Markus (verify served state, no migration needed):
- Anth.us-Papyrus: live anth.us (S3 projection; Gatsby AnthusAI/Anth.us is superseded and its rename belongs to the repository-renames thread)
- Pilobol.us, Threat-Intelligence, p.apyr.us, Kanbus-web: Next + @anthusai/papyrus pods

Papyrus + Markus builds that exist but are not fully cut over (finish, do not rebuild):
- Papyrus-web (marketing, S3 projection, pipeline working)
- Prospectus-web (pr.ospect.us, deploy in progress)
- Apricity-web (build_markus_site, nothing routed to production)
- Auritus-web (source separation ready, live migration not complete; legacy-site/ Next app to retire)

Not on Papyrus yet:
- Markus site/ (3 pure Markus pages, GitHub Pages)
- Cyclotron-web (Next.js marketing, cyclotron.anth.us, interactive previews)
- Chattic.us-web (Next.js marketing + wiki/blog Markdown, waitlist/Stripe intake infra)
- Docs sites (Kanbus mkdocs; Tactus, Biblicus, Cyclotron docs folders)
- Tactus-web (Gatsby + MDX + @anthus/tactus-hitl-components)
- Tactus books: Learning-Tactus, Programming-Tactus, Tactus-in-a-Nutshell (Quarto)
- Anth.us (Gatsby, superseded; archive only)

Order is by ease. Deploys go through the DevOps pipeline, not local AWS.
